author: Dabbler Platform contributors
name: Dabbler CRUD Page Slice
description: Item template that scaffolds a Blazor Server CRUD slice for a single entity: the list page (MudDataGrid + DeclarativeFilterPanel), the detail/edit page (MudForm + EditSession + DirtyAwareActionRow), and the typed HttpClient + IGridDataProvider that bridge to the dabbler-crud-service endpoints. Pre-stage the DTO ({Entity}Dto.cs) before invoking. Per-property grid columns / form fields / filter properties are filled in by a companion Apply-{Entity}Schema.ps1 post-process script that reads the .dabbler-entity.json schema after generation; without it the slice still emits a compilable Id-only fallback.

entity.description: Entity class name (PascalCase). Drives type names, file names, and the singular surfaces inside the generated pages.

entityPlural.description: Entity plural class name (PascalCase). Drives the list-page folder + file name and the lowercased route URL.

webNamespace.description: Web project root namespace (e.g., 'AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web'). Generated namespaces hang off this root.

sharedNamespace.description: Shared project root namespace (e.g., 'AcmeCoffeeOnline.Shared'). Accepted for symmetry with the service template; not directly referenced in this template's content.

dtoNamespace.description: Namespace containing {Entity}Dto (typically the Shared project's DTO namespace, e.g., 'AcmeCoffeeOnline.Shared.DTOs').

apiBaseUrlConfigKey.description: Configuration key consulted by the generated AddT1EntityScaffolding extension to resolve the API base URL. Defaults to 'Services:ApiBaseUrl' and falls back to 'ApiBaseUrl' before the hardcoded localhost default.

pkType.description: Primary-key CLR type for the entity. Defaults to 'int'. Use 'long', 'Guid', etc. for non-int PKs. Must match the schema file's primaryKey.type and the EF entity's Id property type.

schema.description: Path (relative to the working directory at template-invocation time) to a .dabbler-entity.json schema file. Stamped into the generated Apply-{Entity}Schema.ps1 as its default schema location, so re-running the script picks the same file automatically. Required per the crud-scaffolding spec — the page template enumerates fields on the grid, in the form, and in the filter config, and the schema is the per-property input. The schema file lists each property's name + type + per-surface flags (isInGrid, isInForm, isFilterable, isSortable, isReadOnly).
